title: spine-gsps: evaluation harness for a deployed DICOM spine-labelling service
description: Evaluation harness accompanying the article "Separating conformance from trustworthiness: an audit of the delivery path, and eight checks, for an AI result sent to a clinical archive". Every number in the article has a row in docs/CLAIMS.md recording its status, the command that produces it, and its source, including twenty-nine retired claims, seven of them withdrawn on peer review and one withdrawing every count from clinical material.
